leadText:
Ultimo (Japanese: ウルティモ Ultimo) is a minor recurring character in .

He first appeared in Curtain Up, Unova League!, where he participated in the Vertress Conference and was Virgil's first opponent. Their battle began off-screen. Ultimo attempted to keep distance between his Pokémon and Virgil's to make up for Crustle's slower speed. He blocked an oncoming with , but Crustle was later hit by several direct attacks.

In Mission: Defeat Your Rival!, Ultimo was defeated by Virgil and subsequently eliminated from the tournament.
